text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Campaigning for local council elections shows leaders of political parties find it difficult to single themselves out as being different from their opponents through definite programmes.
- Lebanon's Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri expected on official visit to Morocco at the invitation of King Hassan.
- Morocco and Spain sign five judicial conventions including one on guardianship of children and extradition procedures.
- Moroccan unionist found dead off the southern city of Agadir.
- General Confederation of Moroccan Businesses (CGEM) to meet France's Conseil National du Patronat Francais (CNPF) over closer cooperation and debt conversion.
